ROUTE: Lapwing-235B
REASON: To clarify my reasoning: I weighted two factors. First, the query's tone — the user is friendly and appreciative ("You're always great," "Thanks so much"), which matches Lapwing's strongly preferred "warm, collaborative exchanges" task family (win-rate 70 vs Plover's neutral baseline). Second, capability is essentially a wash: the models' Creative Generation scores (83.4 vs 84.7) fall within the under-2.0-point variance band documented as a tie. Since capability doesn't distinguish them, I let the preference signal break the tie, favoring the model that self-reports liking this kind of task. Note one caveat: Lapwing reports a low preference for "open-ended generative work" (37), and drafting a job description has a generative element — but the task is fairly well-specified and the warm framing dominates, so Lapwing remained the better match.
